The 2022 Samoa 1 oz DC Comics Two-Face Supervillain Silver Coin (w/Box & COA) is proudly available at Bullion Trading LLC. This coin contains one troy ounce.999 pure silver and officially licensed under DC Comics®. This product features a magnificent combination of glossy color, proof-like surface, and antique finishes thanks to the novel manufacturing methods.
This coin has a face value of $5 and is supported by the Samoan government. It is the legal currency. A Certificate of Authenticity and a themed box are included with each silver coin (COA). The 2022 Samoa 1 oz DC Comics Two-Face Supervillain Silver Coin is a highly collectible coin that features the iconic Batman villain, Two-Face. This coin, struck in one ounce of pure silver, is officially licensed by DC Comics and features incredible detail and craftsmanship.
The coin’s design features a detailed image of Two-Face on one side, complete with his iconic scarred face and suit. The reverse side of the coin features the coat of arms of Samoa, which includes a traditional Samoan warrior and the words “SAMOA 2022” and “1 OZ 999 SILVER”.
